description: Evidence Gate v1 (Jira XTRM-99 Experiment A, Substrate XTRM-493): 265 (query, passage) candidates in 104 query groups from real XTRM search runs. Stratum L: 174 ctx_search passages exactly as returned (Pi + Claude Code transcripts); stratum W: 91 ddgs results from replaying Specialists researcher queries once at freeze time. Frozen outside git because passages come from private session logs.

excluded_questions.adds_novel_information: novelty is defined against accepted_evidence, which v1 holds empty
excluded_questions.contradicts_accepted_evidence: needs a sequential accepted_evidence state; v1 is single-pass with accepted_evidence=[]

filters.rules: drop empty and within-group duplicate passages; drop queries with <3 word tokens and duplicate queries; guards.redact applied before truncation to passage_char_limit; L capped at LOCAL_PASSAGES_PER_GROUP in retrieval order

selection.method: per (stratum, source_kind): groups ordered by sha256(f'{seed}:{group_id}') and the first quota/n_kinds taken; quota split evenly across source kinds, remainder to the largest; W sampled before replay so only chosen queries were sent
